_comment: SAPM Data Classification and Compliance Policy — data handling, PII policy, audit log retention, regional restrictions, and license review.
_status: Approved for Alpha mainnet launch gate

tiers.description: Market metadata, aggregated forecast outcomes, on-chain transaction digests, and published API responses. May be freely shared.
tiers.retentionPolicy: Indefinite or until market is archived

tiers.description: Agent telemetry, structured logs without user-identifying fields, CI/CD artifacts, and deployment configs.
Wallet addresses, user session tokens, trade amounts, and portfolio positions. Restricted to service principals with need-to-know.
tiers.retentionPolicy: Minimum required for dispute resolution; maximum 2 years
tiers.accessControl: Encrypted at rest and in transit; least-privilege service accounts only

tiers.description: Private key material, attestation secrets, break-glass credentials, and signing keys. Never logged, never transmitted unencrypted.
tiers.retentionPolicy: In-process only; purged on process exit or key rotation
tiers.accessControl: HSM/KMS only; no plaintext storage permitted

piiHandlingPolicy.logRedaction: PII fields must not appear in structured log output. Wallet addresses in logs must be truncated to first 6 + last 4 characters.
piiHandlingPolicy.storageEncryption: All SENSITIVE-tier data persisted to disk must use AES-256 encryption at rest.
piiHandlingPolicy.transmissionEncryption: All SENSITIVE-tier data transmitted over network must use TLS 1.2 or higher.
piiHandlingPolicy.retentionEnforcement: Automated retention cleanup runs are required for any SENSITIVE-tier data store with a defined maximum retention window.
piiHandlingPolicy.deletionOnRequest: User data deletion requests must be processed within 30 days per applicable privacy regulation.

auditLogPolicy.retentionPeriod: 1 year minimum; 3 years for security-relevant events (key rotations, break-glass access, admin actions)
auditLogPolicy.immutability: Audit logs are written to append-only storage. Log entries must not be modified or deleted after creation. Immutability enforced via write-once storage or cryptographic chaining.
auditLogPolicy.scope: All security-relevant events: authentication, key access, privilege escalation, circuit-breaker trips, rollback events, break-glass credential use.
auditLogPolicy.format: Structured JSON with timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC), principal, action, resource, outcome, and correlation ID.

targetRegions: Global — no region-specific data residency requirements identified for Alpha mainnet
regionalPolicy.restrictions: No personally identifiable financial data is stored server-side. On-chain data is public by nature of the Sui blockchain. Users are responsible for compliance with applicable local regulations for cryptocurrency participation.
regionalPolicy.futureReview: Regional restrictions review must be repeated before expansion into EU (GDPR), US (FinCEN), or APAC-regulated jurisdictions.

thirdPartyLicenseReview.method: package.json and frontend/package.json license fields audited; primary dependencies use Apache-2.0, MIT, and BSD licenses. All are compatible with SAPM Apache-2.0 license.
thirdPartyLicenseReview.openItems: Periodic re-review required on each release to catch newly added dependencies.
thirdPartyLicenseReview.ciEnforcement: Recommend adding license-checker to dependency-audit CI job for automated detection of GPL or proprietary licenses.
